About.title: about
About.description1: Hi! I'm Pedro Henrique, a Full Stack Software Engineer with nearly 6 years of experience building web, mobile, and desktop applications. Throughout my career, I've worked primarily with React, React Native, Node.js, and TypeScript, contributing to enterprise software such as ERP systems, mobile applications, and point-of-sale solutions.
About.description2: I enjoy understanding the problem before designing the solution. I'm particularly interested in software architecture, code organization, and performance, always aiming to build applications that are scalable, maintainable, and easy to evolve. I also enjoy contributing to technical decisions and helping define the best approach for each project.
About.description3: Outside of work, I enjoy building personal projects to experiment with new ideas and explore different architectures and technologies.

work.shortDescription: Developed and evolved a complete business management software ecosystem, including a web ERP, mobile application, and desktop point-of-sale system.
actions: Built and maintained a multi-tenant ERP serving over 50 companies using React
Developed a Node.js REST API that centralized Pix payments, bank slips, and electronic invoice (NF-e) processing for seven applications
Implemented automated testing with Vitest, Playwright, and Maestro, reducing production regressions
Architected and developed a desktop POS application with electronic invoicing (NF-e/NFC-e) using Electron
